fluff.overview: Reforms begun under Alessandro Steiner and reinforced by Federated Suns influence have integrated Lyran infantry into combined-arms operations more effectively than at any point in the Commonwealth's history. Mechanized hover platoons ride into battle aboard hovercraft that provide both speed and the ability to cross water and rough terrain without slowing, making them effective rapid-reaction forces. Armed with assault rifles and infantry-portable long-range missile launchers, these platoons can engage armored targets at distances well beyond normal infantry weapon range, providing indirect fire support to the formation.
